what: This repository's own exemptions for the register (Cantonese) axis, and a working example of the mechanism. A project keeps this file at its root; the tool never ships one.

allow.why: 說明語體軸時刻意引用粵語標記當例子
整篇都在引用粵語當範例，那是文件的目的
說明資料來源時引用範例
攔截訊息就是給模型看的改寫範例，必須保留粵語字例
攔截訊息（guardMessage）搬來這裡了，同樣要保留粵語字例；lib.js 是 hook 與外掛共用的決策來源
測試資料本來就是粵語（.tradzhignore 已整檔跳過，這條只讓意圖也寫明白）

note: Genuinely Cantonese source files in another project go here too - that is what the file is for. Note that this exemption covers ONLY the register axis: Simplified glyphs in these same files are still reported (references/cantonese.md carries a simplified-example marker for exactly that reason).
